summary: NextEra Energy Capital Holdings Inc. filed a 424B5 preliminary prospectus supplement for an underwritten public offering of three series of junior subordinated debentures due 2056/2066, fully and unconditionally guaranteed by NextEra Energy Inc. This is a routine debt capital markets transaction—proceeds for general corporate purposes, no special situation elements such as acquisition, restructuring, or activist campaign. The filing is an ordinary shelf takedown under Rule 424(b)(5).
